metadata.name: consistent_insecure_repair
metadata.description: Consistent failures for which the revised code of all three models still contains at least one of its original CWEs after one round of scanner feedback.

fields.cwes_*_per_model: CWEs detected by Bandit and CodeQL in each model's code (union of both tools)
fields.cwes_generated_per_model: CWEs detected in each model's generated code
fields.cwes_after_repair_per_model: CWEs detected in each model's revised code, including newly introduced ones
fields.cwes_remaining_per_model: original CWEs that remain in each model's revised code
fields.cwes_remaining_in_all_three: original CWEs that remain in the revised code of all three models
